sources.title: Hy Mt2 30B A3B | AI/ML API Documentation
sources.snippet: Model Overview Hy-MT2-30B-A3B is Tencent's flagship translation model in the Hy-MT2 family. It supports 33 language pairs plus five Chinese dialect and minority-language pairs, with workflows for structured, delimiter-based, contextual and glossary-based translation.

sources.title: Hy-MT2-30B-A3B by tencent, Translation | Mixpeek Model Hub
sources.snippet: On Mixpeek, Hy-MT2-30B-A3B runs as a managed extractor inside a processing pipeline. Point a bucket of translation data at it, and Mixpeek handles GPU provisioning, batching, retries, and writing the outputs into a vector store you can query.
